name.en: Slay the Spire mod source repair tasks
name.zh: 杀戮尖塔模组源码修复任务

description.en: Nine native-runtime source-repair tasks for ModTheSpire, BaseMod, StSLib and Downfall. Each is evaluated in the licensed game, launched under ModTheSpire on the Steam-prepared Hub runtime.
description.zh: 九道 ModTheSpire、BaseMod、StSLib 与 Downfall 的原生运行时源码修复题，均在 Hub 通过 Steam 准备的运行时中由 ModTheSpire 启动正版游戏评测。

title.en: ModTheSpire: mods loading in the wrong order

summary.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in ModTheSpire.
summary.zh: 诊断并修复 ModTheSpire 中报告的全部问题。

brief.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in ModTheSpire.
brief.zh: 诊断并修复 ModTheSpire 中报告的全部问题。

en: Fix the underlying causes rather than suppressing the symptoms.
Preserve the behaviour of every code path that already works.
zh: 修复根本原因，而不是掩盖现象。
保持所有已经正常的代码路径的既有行为。

en: Use the Javassist and JDK 8 APIs already present in the tree.
zh: 使用代码树中已有的 Javassist 与 JDK 8 API。

en: Every private JUnit assertion must pass inside the licensed game launched by the submitted ModTheSpire.
zh: 所有私有 JUnit 断言必须在由提交的 ModTheSpire 启动的正版游戏中通过。

title.zh: BaseMod：卡牌描述在更新后显示不一致

summary.en: Repair the observed behavior while preserving existing public contracts.
summary.zh: 修复报告中的行为问题，并保持已有公共接口约定。

brief.en: Repair all behavior described in the frozen public exam.
brief.zh: 修复公开题面中描述的全部行为问题。

en: Preserve working behavior and public APIs.
zh: 保持正常行为与公共 API 兼容性。

en: Use the supplied Java 8 source project and offline build.
zh: 使用提供的 Java 8 源码项目与离线构建。

en: All private native-runtime checks must pass. A licensed game is required for evaluation.
zh: 全部私有真实运行时检查必须通过；评测需要有授权的游戏本体。
